name: Vapor Game Access
description: Official game-access actions split out of the agent host (ASF-style): play/idle/card-drop farming, playtime, licenses & keys, achievements read/write, inventory reads, duplicate scans & 1:1 swaps, loot (trade-to-self) and points shop. Action names and payload schemas are unchanged; the agent Docker image bundles this plugin so out-of-the-box behavior is identical.
